defense_dimensions.name: 回归防护充分
defense_dimensions.description: 变更已有充分的伴随测试或上下游防护，不构成实际回归隐患

description: 对代码仓库最近一周的提交变更 (最近一周 commit) 进行全面的 AI 审查，确保多线程安全、内存泄漏、第三方库引用符合标准
name: change_review

categories.label: 内存与并发安全-资源泄漏
categories.definition: A changed hunk creates or prolongs unreachable ownership of memory or another resource without a release path.
decision_rules: owned allocation or resource is introduced
release is absent from all reachable paths
negative_hints: error path releases or transfers ownership

categories.label: 内存与并发安全-数据竞争
categories.definition: A changed hunk introduces unsynchronized shared mutable state or removes an existing happens-before edge.
decision_rules: shared state is read and written across threads

categories.label: 内存与并发安全-生命周期错误
categories.definition: A changed hunk invalidates object lifetime, ownership, or callback safety.
decision_rules: object can be used after release or destruction
callback or captured reference may outlive owner

categories.label: 变更正确性-逻辑漏洞
categories.definition: A changed hunk implements behavior that does not satisfy its stated requirement.

categories.label: 变更正确性-边界防御
categories.definition: A changed hunk mishandles an empty, minimum, maximum, error, or overflow boundary.
decision_rules: boundary check is absent or wrong
result is incorrect near the boundary
positive_hints: bounds are checked for all path shapes

categories.label: 变更正确性-回归风险
categories.definition: A changed hunk reopens or preserves a previously fixed defect without adequate protection.
decision_rules: removed guard, assertion, or test correlated with a known failure
positive_hints: removed code is obsolete by design

categories.label: 可观测性-关键分支日志缺失
categories.definition: A changed hunk omits logging from a critical failure or decision branch needed for operations.
decision_rules: failure or security-relevant branch is changed
no log or audit trace exists
positive_hints: log covers the meaningful failure context
negative_hints: pure success path needs no log

categories.label: 可观测性-敏感日志暴露
categories.definition: A changed hunk exposes credentials, tokens, private data, or secrets through logs.

categories.label: 接口兼容性-破坏性变更
categories.definition: A changed hunk breaks a published interface contract without a compatible migration.
decision_rules: existing callers can fail to compile or behave differently

categories.label: 接口兼容性-上下游参数失配
categories.definition: A changed hunk sends or accepts interface parameters that mismatch the upstream or downstream contract.
decision_rules: name, type, unit, range, or nullability differs

categories.label: 质量控制-增量复杂度过高
categories.definition: A changed hunk adds disproportionate branching, nesting, or coupling relative to its behavior.
decision_rules: new nesting or branch count is materially higher
positive_hints: complexity is justified by domain rules

categories.label: 质量控制-重复代码
categories.definition: A changed hunk duplicates existing logic instead of sharing a single implementation.
negative_hints: shared abstraction would couple unrelated rules

categories.label: 其它问题-其它变更风险
categories.definition: A credible change-related risk that does not fit a more specific controlled category.
decision_rules: risk is caused or enabled by the change
